target: Smooth 60 fps on live vlang.io at 1708x953 and 2x
status: Smooth 60 fps remains open. Readback alternatives and tight filter inputs remain opt-in after mixed or confounded live results. The scrollbar batch is committed and awaiting a matching production bundle.
scope: Changed native layer publications with changed scroll position after updateLayer, over the whole first-to-last precise input period; not physical scanout.
protocol: Live HTTPS, automatic author scripting, empty private profile/cache, no proxy overrides, title readiness plus 10 second settle; 600 delta-8 inputs at nominal 120 Hz reversing every 150. Diagnostic schedules and actual timestamps are preserved per run. OS filesystem/shader caches retained.

policies.compact_filter_inputs: Opt-in: 78.18 to 89.19 and 90.39 to 90.30 fps; mixed p95.
policies.iosurface_snapshot_copy: Rejected: live transport errors up to 11 levels before input; no acceptance cohort.
policies.iosurface_compute_copy: Opt-in: 86.43 to 75.83 and 78.62 to 79.54 fps; exact integer texels replace the rejected image-copy path.
policies.partial_readback: Opt-in: 77.69 to 91.74 and 90.50 to 77.45 fps; 151 live checks prove no changed pixels outside bounds and 38 percent fewer transferred pixels in that diagnostic.
policies.tight_filter_inputs: Opt-in: 72.68 to 73.30 and 68.52 to 69.85 fps; falling host load is a confound. 768 exact frame comparisons in each of O2 and sanitizer modes. Live diagnostic input bytes 669399360 to 1095324.
policies.combined_partial_video: Opt-in: 86.55 to 81.50 and 83.80 to 73.75 fps; retains both partial reads and video backdrop eligibility.
policies.scrollbar_batch: Opt-in pending live validation; geometry tests execute and 24 native variants remain within the existing GPU three-level bound, with exact unchanged outside pixels.

limitations: Native publications do not measure physical scanout.
The shared production bundle publication temporarily waits for an unrelated browser lease. No other session was stopped.
A scroll commit captured independently staged CSS/tool changes. Linear index-only correction a9b6c94b4 restored their working and staged intent; 5871c2903 subsequently owns the CSS changes.

The first scrollbar overlay test assumed exact zero channel error; the actual two-level blending difference is within the pre-existing GPU canvas bound of three, and the final fixture retains that bound plus exact outside pixels.
The first three failed-readback fixture attempts had setup or pixel-coordinate assertion errors. Final attempt 4 passes the forced two-failure replay and all existing GPU tests.
Snapshot-copy timing was not collected after live exactness failed. Compute and partial diagnostics are separate from unprofiled timings.
